headline: Weathered Expanse Fighting Rages; Callahan's Passage Still Contested
war_summary: The heaviest fighting continues in Weathered Expanse, where forty-five base events are recorded over the past twenty-four hours, four of them within the last two, and where two of nine bases stand neutral; casualties there remain the largest on the map, though the hourly rate has cooled from its earlier peak. Callahan's Passage has logged four events in six hours, two in the last two, with Warden colours over eight bases, one Colonial and one neutral, and it too was active at the current hour. Stlican Shelf reported fresh events at the cutoff, standing five Colonial, three Warden and one neutral. Mooring County, which carried the day's heaviest tolls, near 9,650 Colonial and 10,060 Warden casualties, has gone quiet for six hours, its seventeen events of the day behind it; Wardens hold eleven of its twelve bases. Palantine Berm and Nevish Line show little recent activity. Colonials retain the great majority of bases across the map, while Warden colours hold twelve regions entire. Enlistments remain brisk in the contested sectors.
